show_title: Invest Like the Best with Patrick O'Shaughnessy
title: Meb Faber - Factors, Dividends, and Angel Investing - [Invest Like the Best, EP.53]
summary: Meb is a quantitative researcher whose firm Cambria has been behind many interesting investment strategies that break the Wall Street mold. We talk investing factors, dividends, angel investing, podcasts and more. This was a fun catch up with a close friend in the industry who has been in a leader in using data to explore the best active strategies in a variety of asset classes.
